profile.headline: Senior Principal Software Engineer at Dell Technologies

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
I develop web applications that give team members the tools and insights needed to ensure a high quality customer experience.

Technologies used: ASP.NET (CSS/HTML/JavaScript/C#), VueJS, Pyhton, SQL

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
Courses: Applied Statistics and Differential Equations
Held office hours, graded student’s work, and facilitated two 50-minute conferences a week (20-30 students) or a 2 hour lab to go over course material, answer questions, and administer quizzes/labs.

positions.title: Business Analyst Intern
positions.description: Analyzed sales data using Alteryx and Tableau. Performed feature engineering and trained a model to predict sales turnover rates given certain deal specifications. Provided key insights to the company to improve its sales performance.

positions.title: Information Technology Intern
positions.description: Worked as part of an agile team of software developers to create a tool in Python to de-identify health files containing personal health information.

projects.title: Master's Thesis
projects.description: Developed  a  computational  model  to  simulate  EM  and  thermal  processes  in a simplified MMW heat exchanger and examined different ceramic materials to find the one that maximizes the device’s efficiency

projects.title: Major Qualifying Project - Improving Employer Outcomes: Supervised Learning to Predict Hiring Success
projects.description: Modeled data from WPI’s Career and Development Center (CDC) using machine learning in Python to find which factors best predict hiring success for employers looking to hire WPI students.
